hero.headline: Know the Risk. Plan a Safer Route.
hero.subtext: FloodWatch India combines weather forecasts, river observations, geographical risk data, and community reports to help you make informed decisions during flood events.
hero.disclaimer: This is a decision-support platform, not a replacement for official emergency services.

utilityBar.disclaimer: This platform provides decision support only. Always follow official emergency instructions.

risk.provisional: Provisional estimate — model not yet calibrated

map.title: Live Flood Map
map.selectArea: Select an area to view details

rainfall.title: Rainfall
rainfall.notFloodForecast: This is a weather forecast, not a flood forecast.

rivers.title: River Monitoring
rivers.gloFASDisclaimer: River discharge values are from the GloFAS hydrological model via Open-Meteo. These are model estimates, not official Indian gauge observations.

routes.title: Safe Route Planner
routes.disclaimer: Route recommendations are based on available data and do not guarantee safety. Always use local knowledge and follow official guidance.
routes.noRoutes: No routes found for the selected locations.

reports.title: Report Flooding
reports.unverified: Reports are initially UNVERIFIED and reviewed before influencing risk scores.
reports.success: Report submitted successfully. It will be reviewed before appearing on the map.

facilities.title: Hospitals & Shelters
facilities.disclaimer: Verify facility status before travelling. Operational status may change during emergencies.

coverage.title: Data Coverage
coverage.explanation: Real-time data is not available for all Indian districts. Gaps are shown explicitly rather than estimated.

errors.fetchFailed: Unable to fetch data. Please try again.
errors.locationPermission: Location access denied. Please search manually.
errors.routeNotFound: Could not calculate a route for these locations.
errors.apiError: An error occurred. Please refresh the page.
